'''Zhang Hanxin''' (1 January 1936 – 1 October 2021) was a Chinese scientist specializing in [[fluid mechanics]], and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=4 October 2021 |script-title=zh:张涵信院士逝世 |language=zh |work=[[Guangming Daily]] |url=https://epaper.gmw.cn/gmrb/html/2021-10/04/nw.D110000gmrb_20211004_6-02.htm |access-date=2021-11-05}}</ref> He was chairman of Chinese Aerodynamics Research Society.

==Biography==
Zhang was born in [[Pei County]], [[Jiangsu]], on 1 January 1936, during the [[Republic of China (1912–1949)|Republic of China]]. He secondary studied at Xuzhou No. 2 High School. In 1954, he enrolled at [[Tsinghua University]], majoring in the Department of Hydraulic Engineering.<ref name="cat">{{cite news|url=http://casad.cas.cn/sourcedb_ad_cas/zw2/ysxx/sxwlxb/200906/t20090624_1791972.html |script-title=zh:张涵信 |work=cas.cn |date=2019 |access-date=3 October 2021 |language=zh}}</ref> In 1963, he did his postgraduate work at the Institute of Mechanics, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] under the supervision of [[Guo Yonghuai]].<ref name="cat"/> At the same time, he taught at Tsinghua University. In 1972, he was despatched to the [[China Aerodynamics Research and Development Center]] as a researcher.

On 1 October 2021, he died from an illness in [[Beijing]], aged 85.<ref>{{Cite news |date=3 October 2021 |script-title=zh:中国计算流体力学奠基人之一张涵信院士逝世 |language=zh |work=[[China News Service]] |url=https://www.chinanews.com/gn/2021/10-03/9579293.shtml |access-date=3 October 2021}}</ref>
